successors.name: Ottoman Empire
successors.text: Cilicia, the beylik incorporated by Selim I

ledger.x: 1352: Ramazan Beg settles the Yüreğir Turkmens south of Çaldağı (first settlement Camili) and, visiting Cairo the same year, is 'assented by the Sultan' to found a frontier Turkmen emirate in Cilicia.

Page silent on the date of the handover: after the Mamluks took Sis in 1375 ('ending three centuries of Armenian rule') they 'authorized the Türkmen emirate to administer Cilicia' while keeping Tarsus, Ayas, Sarvandikar and Sis.
1516: Selim I incorporates the beylik into the Ottoman Empire after conquering the Mamluk state ('In 1516, Selim I incorporated the beylik'); the infobox begins the Ottoman protectorate in 1517.
1516: the independent emirate ends when Selim I incorporates it; the dynasty keeps the sanjak of Adana as an Ottoman protectorate (1517-1608).

wars.name: Mamluk conquest of Armenian Cilicia
wars.outcome: Mamluks invade Cilicia again in 1343-44, take Adana and Tarsus in 1359 and Sis and Gaban in 1375, ending the Armenian kingdom; the Ramadanid Turkmen emirate administers the plain under Mamluk protection.

wars.name: Ottoman-Mamluk War (1516-1517)
wars.outcome: Marj Dabiq (24 August 1516) and Ridaniya (24 January 1517) give the Ottomans Syria and Egypt; Selim I incorporates the Ramadanid beylik in 1516; a Ramazanoglu Bey is listed killed on the Mamluk side.

certainty.note: A frontier emirate of the Cilician plain under Mamluk protection to c.
